objective: Define the first independent complete source-closure reference promotion after the known-template reference inventory found no independent complete references.

selected_candidate.reason: This tracked full ITA/MHA template is outside the paged-attention copied-filelist lineage, already carries an explicit 29-file ITA/common_cells/overlay source list, and is closer to the long-term modern attention workload goal than the smaller NVDLA CMAC candidates.

pulp_ita_dotp.reason: It is small and attention-score-like, but its current template source_files list has only the leaf RTL plus overlay path in the dry-run plan, making it a weaker complete-closure reference unless the minimal leaf-only boundary is explicitly accepted.

pulp_ita_mha.reason: It is the best first independent reference for the long-term goal because it is not a copied derivative, has a full explicit source list, already has scoped coverage-output equivalence evidence, and represents integrated attention datapath behavior.

nvdla_cmac_core_mac.reason: It gives a clearer independent target-family reference with a compact source list and existing build/run/compare evidence, but it is CNN-era CMAC evidence and is farther from the modern LLM-serving RTL workload goal.

nvdla_cmac_a2cacc.reason: It is independent and small, but the current source list is only one upstream RTL file; core_mac gives a more useful multi-file closure boundary first.

non_claims: not proof that the ITA/MHA closure is correct for arbitrary ITA or filelist targets
not proof that the promoted closure generalizes to arbitrary RTL
